name: Lorea Intxausti
bio:
Lorea Intxausti Oregi (Donosti, Gipuzkoa) is a basque film, theater, and television actress.

In 2012 she won the Donostia Short Story Competition for Peace and Human Rights, and in 2014 she was awarded a prize in the Eduardo Chillida Mathematics Olympiad of the Basque Country. She studied at the Axular Lizeoa school. Then she completed her secondary education at the La Salle Donostia Ikastetxea school. She finished her secondary education first in her class, with a perfect 10 average and received the distinction of honors for the best academic record.
